Title: Fetching balance state on Bybit returns an empty list
Description: - OS: Windows 10 (WSL2 Ubuntu 20.04)
- Programming Language version: Node.js 18
- CCXT version: 1.92.89

Fetching a balance returns all 0. It does not work both on mainnet and testnet.

Balance amount for all symbols is returned as 0. API key and secret is a correct one.
Switching from bybit to binance exchange successfully returns a correct amount of balance, but not on bybit.

My actual balance on testnet is: 112,294.98 USD (≈5.82435910 BTC)

```
const ccxt = require('ccxt')

(async () => {
  const exchange = new ccxt.bybit({
    apiKey: 'xxx',
    secret: 'xxx'
  })
  
  const balance = await exchange.fetchBalance()
  console.log(balance)
})()
```
